name: NeRFshop
aliases: Interactive Editing of Neural Radiance Fields
definition: An end-to-end method for interactive editing of full NeRF scenes, allowing users to select and deform objects through cage-based transformations, with GPU-friendly two-level interpolation and volumetric membrane interpolation to reduce artifacts.
summary: NeRFshop is an end-to-end method for the interactive editing of full Neural Radiance Field scenes, distinguished by its real-time cage-based deformation on Instant-NGP without retraining.
